guess_property_metadata: guess metadata for all properties in a list of ASE atoms objects including info and calculator results
guess_target_metadata: guess shape, type, and extensiveness metadata for a single target property given atom lengths and samples
target_extensive: determine whether a property is intensive or extensive by checking per-atom normalized variation against a threshold
target_per_atom: check if a target is per-atom by verifying the first dimension matches the number of atoms
target_constant_shape: check if target samples have a constant shape regardless of varying atom sizes
